summary: Confirmed all three paired personalised-versus-standard GenAI estimates: originality, quality and elaboration. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendix Tables A1-A2, and checked the cited PDF pages with PyMuPDF. Every recorded mean, SD, z statistic, p-value, Cohen’s r, confidence limit and 95% confidence level matches the correct row and arm in Table 2 (PDF p. 11, printed p. 175). The negative z and r signs are printed as recorded, including for quality and elaboration despite their higher personalised-condition means. The study-level final sample of 62 is printed on PDF p. 5 (printed p. 169); analysis-specific participant or valid-pair counts are not printed, so the null estimate counts are justified. PDF pp. 7-10 (printed pp. 171-174) support the recorded constructs, human-rater measure, score direction, AI availability, immediate timing, AI-design comparison and paired analysis. Figure 3 on PDF p. 9, inspected in memory, explicitly identifies random assignment of feedback sequence. The paper specifies averaging across raters but does not establish how the requested solutions become observations in Table 2; null unit and SD level and se_basis=unclear appropriately retain that uncertainty. No additional eligible outcome, first-round result or full-sample contrast was found. Feedback-uptake and interaction measures are process outcomes; the within-condition correlations and regressions are not randomized AI-condition contrasts. The appendix supplies intervention settings and examples without additional outcome statistics.
